articles.summary: COVINGTON, La., Oct. 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Pool Corporation (Nasdaq:POOL) announced today that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $1.30 per share. The dividend will be payable on November 25, 2026 to holders of record on November 11, 2026. Pool Corporation is the world’s largest wholesale distributor of swimming pool and related backyard products. POOLCORP operates approximately 455 sales centers in North America, Europe and Australia, through which it distributes more than 200,000 products to roughly 125,000 wholesale customers. For more information, please visit www.poolcorp.com. CONTACT: Kristin S. ByarsDirector, Investor Relations and Finance985.801.5153kristin.byars@poolcorp.com

articles.summary: Q3 2026 Highlights: Net sales increased 4% to $1.5 billion, accelerating from 2% growth in the second quarter, supported by price, solid maintenance growth and continued improvement in building materials Operating income decreased 3% to $172.2 million from $178.0 million in Q3 2025 Diluted EPS consistent with Q3 2025 at $3.40; adjusted diluted EPS increased $0.01 Confirms annual earnings guidance range of $10.66 to $10.96 per diluted share, and adjusted diluted earnings guidance range of $10.87 to $11.17 per share including $0.02 of year-to-date ASU 2016-09 tax benefits COVINGTON, La., Oct. 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Pool Corporation (Nasdaq: POOL) today reported results for the third quarter of 2026. “Building on our performance through the first half of the year, we delivered solid results in the third quarter of 2026 as we moved through the end of the peak selling season. Our dedicated teams produced top-line growth by delivering to our customers when they needed it the most. At the same time, we remained committed to disciplined capital allocation, reducing inventory by 3% while growing sales. articles.summary: COVINGTON, La., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Pool Corporation (Nasdaq: POOL) announced today that the Company will release its third quarter 2026 earnings results before the market opens on October 22, 2026, and will hold a conference call to discuss the results at 10:00 a.m. Central Time (11:00 a.m. Eastern Time) that same day. The earnings release as well as a live webcast and replay of the conference call will be available on the Company’s website at www.poolcorp.com. The conference call can also be accessed by dialing 1-888-348-8936 (domestic) or 1-412-902-4265 (international).
